employee_employment_period_dates_valid.name: employee_employment_period_dates_valid
employee_employment_period_dates_valid.value: "employee_employment_period"."start_date" between date '1900-01-01' and date '2100-12-31' and ("employee_employment_period"."end_date" is null or ("employee_employment_period"."end_date" >= "employee_employment_period"."start_date" and "employee_employment_period"."end_date" <= date '2100-12-31'))

company_schedule_day_hours_valid.name: company_schedule_day_hours_valid
company_schedule_day_hours_valid.value: ("company_schedule_day"."start_time" is null and "company_schedule_day"."end_time" is null) or ("company_schedule_day"."start_time" is not null and "company_schedule_day"."end_time" is not null and "company_schedule_day"."start_time" < "company_schedule_day"."end_time" and extract(second from "company_schedule_day"."start_time") = 0 and extract(second from "company_schedule_day"."end_time") = 0 and "company_schedule_day"."end_time" < time '24:00:00')

employee_work_location_day_valid.name: employee_work_location_day_valid
employee_work_location_day_valid.value: ("employee_work_location"."weekday" is null and "employee_work_location"."date" is not null) or ("employee_work_location"."weekday" is not null and "employee_work_location"."weekday" between 1 and 7 and "employee_work_location"."date" is null and "employee_work_location"."remote")

employee_schedule_version_source_valid.name: employee_schedule_version_source_valid
employee_schedule_version_source_valid.value: ("employee_schedule_version"."source" = 'migration' and "employee_schedule_version"."actor_id" is null) or "employee_schedule_version"."source" = 'provisioned' or ("employee_schedule_version"."source" = 'changed' and "employee_schedule_version"."actor_id" is not null)

attendance_review_values_valid.name: attendance_review_values_valid
attendance_review_values_valid.value: "attendance_session"."revision" >= 0 and "attendance_session"."approved_outside_seconds" >= 0 and ("attendance_session"."review_state" = 'approved' or "attendance_session"."approved_outside_seconds" = 0) and "attendance_session"."max_open_hours" between 8 and 72

job_coordinates_valid.name: job_coordinates_valid
job_coordinates_valid.value: ("job"."longitude" is null and "job"."latitude" is null) or ("job"."longitude" is not null and "job"."latitude" is not null and "job"."longitude" between -180 and 180 and "job"."latitude" between -85 and 85)

job_text_valid.name: job_text_valid
job_text_valid.value: char_length(trim("job"."title")) between 3 and 160 and char_length("job"."notes") <= 4000 and char_length("job"."address") <= 300

job_deadline_valid.name: job_deadline_valid
job_deadline_valid.value: "job"."deadline" is null or "job"."deadline" between date '1900-01-01' and date '2100-12-31'

job_geofence_valid.name: job_geofence_valid
job_geofence_valid.value: "job"."geofence_diameter" is null or ("job"."geofence_diameter" in (100, 200) and "job"."longitude" is not null and "job"."latitude" is not null)

job_location_labels_valid.name: job_location_labels_valid
job_location_labels_valid.value: char_length("job"."street_name_ka") <= 300 and char_length("job"."street_name_en") <= 300 and char_length("job"."location_label_ka") <= 300 and char_length("job"."location_label_en") <= 300

job_assignment_valid.name: job_assignment_valid
job_assignment_valid.value: ("job"."status" = 'pending' and "job"."assignee_id" is null) or ("job"."status" in ('en_route', 'on_site', 'completed') and "job"."assignee_id" is not null) or "job"."status" = 'rejected'

job_event_note_valid.name: job_event_note_valid
job_event_note_valid.value: char_length("job_event"."note") <= 2000 and ("job_event"."action" <> 'status_changed' or "job_event"."status" not in ('rejected', 'pending') or char_length(trim("job_event"."note")) >= 5)

leave_request_dates_valid.name: leave_request_dates_valid
leave_request_dates_valid.value: ("leave_request"."kind" = 'sick_leave' and ("leave_request"."end_date" is null or "leave_request"."end_date" >= "leave_request"."start_date")) or ("leave_request"."kind" <> 'sick_leave' and "leave_request"."end_date" is not null and "leave_request"."end_date" >= "leave_request"."start_date" and "leave_request"."end_date" - "leave_request"."start_date" <= 365)

leave_request_review_valid.name: leave_request_review_valid
leave_request_review_valid.value: ("leave_request"."reviewer_id" is null and "leave_request"."reviewed_at" is null and "leave_request"."review_reason" = '' and "leave_request"."status" in ('pending', 'cancelled')) or ("leave_request"."reviewer_id" is not null and "leave_request"."reviewer_id" <> "leave_request"."requester_id" and "leave_request"."reviewed_at" is not null and "leave_request"."status" <> 'cancelled' and length("leave_request"."review_reason") <= 500)

vacation_period_year.name: vacation_period_year
vacation_period_year.default: extract(year from now() at time zone 'Asia/Tbilisi')::int

day_off_balance_valid.name: day_off_balance_valid
day_off_balance_valid.value: "day_off_balance"."annual_days" between 0 and 366 and "day_off_balance"."remaining_days" between 0 and 3660 and "day_off_balance"."period_year" between 2000 and 2100 and "day_off_balance"."revision" >= 0 and "day_off_balance"."vacation_annual_days" between 24 and 366 and "day_off_balance"."vacation_remaining_days" between 0 and 100000 and "day_off_balance"."vacation_period_year" between 2000 and 2100

day_off_setting_valid.name: day_off_setting_valid
day_off_setting_valid.value: "day_off_setting"."id" = 1 and "day_off_setting"."default_days" between 0 and 366 and "day_off_setting"."revision" >= 0 and "day_off_setting"."default_vacation_days" between 24 and 366

payroll_payment_amounts.name: payroll_payment_amounts
payroll_payment_amounts.value: "payroll_payment"."base_minor" between 0 and 100000000 and "payroll_payment"."bonus_minor" between 0 and 100000000 and "payroll_payment"."premium_minor" between 0 and 100000000 and "payroll_payment"."fine_minor" between 0 and 100000000 and "payroll_payment"."total_minor" between 0 and 300000000 and "payroll_payment"."total_minor" = "payroll_payment"."base_minor" + "payroll_payment"."bonus_minor" + "payroll_payment"."premium_minor" - "payroll_payment"."fine_minor"

payroll_payment_stage_components.name: payroll_payment_stage_components
payroll_payment_stage_components.value: ("payroll_payment"."stage" = 'adjustments' and "payroll_payment"."base_minor" = 0) or ("payroll_payment"."stage" = 'salary' and "payroll_payment"."bonus_minor" = 0 and "payroll_payment"."premium_minor" = 0) or ("payroll_payment"."stage" = 'first' and "payroll_payment"."bonus_minor" = 0 and "payroll_payment"."premium_minor" = 0 and "payroll_payment"."fine_minor" = 0)

payroll_deduction_dates_valid.name: payroll_deduction_dates_valid
payroll_deduction_dates_valid.value: "payroll_deduction_version"."occurred_on" between date '2000-01-01' and date '2100-12-31' and "payroll_deduction_version"."payroll_month" between date '2000-01-01' and date '2100-12-01' and extract(day from "payroll_deduction_version"."payroll_month") = 1 and "payroll_deduction_version"."payroll_month" >= date_trunc('month', "payroll_deduction_version"."occurred_on")::date

payroll_deduction_evidence_valid.name: payroll_deduction_evidence_valid
payroll_deduction_evidence_valid.value: length(trim("payroll_deduction_version"."reference")) between 3 and 160 and length(trim("payroll_deduction_version"."evidence")) between 5 and 1000 and length(trim("payroll_deduction_version"."basis")) between 5 and 1000 and length(trim("payroll_deduction_version"."reason")) between 5 and 500 and "payroll_deduction_version"."employment_revision" > 0 and length("payroll_deduction_version"."timezone") between 1 and 100 and "payroll_deduction_version"."command_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'

payroll_monthly_entry_scope.name: payroll_monthly_entry_scope
payroll_monthly_entry_scope.value: "payroll_monthly_entry"."version" > 0 and "payroll_monthly_entry"."month" between date '2000-01-01' and date '2100-12-01' and extract(day from "payroll_monthly_entry"."month") = 1 and "payroll_monthly_entry"."status" in ('draft','finalized','voided')

payroll_monthly_entry_amounts.name: payroll_monthly_entry_amounts
payroll_monthly_entry_amounts.value: "payroll_monthly_entry"."base_minor" between 0 and 100000000 and "payroll_monthly_entry"."bonus_minor" between 0 and 100000000 and "payroll_monthly_entry"."premium_minor" between 0 and 100000000 and "payroll_monthly_entry"."fine_minor" between 0 and 100000000 and "payroll_monthly_entry"."total_minor" between -100000000 and 100000000 and ("payroll_monthly_entry"."salary" is null or "payroll_monthly_entry"."total_minor" >= 0) and "payroll_monthly_entry"."total_minor" = "payroll_monthly_entry"."base_minor" + "payroll_monthly_entry"."bonus_minor" + "payroll_monthly_entry"."premium_minor" - "payroll_monthly_entry"."fine_minor"

payroll_monthly_entry_payment_options.name: payroll_monthly_entry_payment_options
payroll_monthly_entry_payment_options.value: ("payroll_monthly_entry"."first_payment_minor" is null or "payroll_monthly_entry"."first_payment_minor" between 0 and "payroll_monthly_entry"."base_minor") and ("payroll_monthly_entry"."fine_stage" is null or "payroll_monthly_entry"."fine_stage" in ('salary','adjustments'))

payroll_monthly_entry_salary_snapshot.name: payroll_monthly_entry_salary_snapshot
payroll_monthly_entry_salary_snapshot.value: ("payroll_monthly_entry"."salary" is not null and "payroll_monthly_entry"."source_token" is not null) or ("payroll_monthly_entry"."salary" is null and "payroll_monthly_entry"."source_token" is null and "payroll_monthly_entry"."status" <> 'finalized' and "payroll_monthly_entry"."base_minor" = 0 and "payroll_monthly_entry"."worked_seconds" = 0 and not "payroll_monthly_entry"."manual_base" and "payroll_monthly_entry"."base_reason" = '')

payroll_monthly_entry_evidence.name: payroll_monthly_entry_evidence
payroll_monthly_entry_evidence.value: length(trim("payroll_monthly_entry"."reason")) between 5 and 500 and length("payroll_monthly_entry"."base_reason") <= 500 and (not "payroll_monthly_entry"."manual_base" or length(trim("payroll_monthly_entry"."base_reason")) >= 5) and jsonb_typeof("payroll_monthly_entry"."adjustments") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("payroll_monthly_entry"."adjustments") <= 20 and ("payroll_monthly_entry"."source_token" is null or "payroll_monthly_entry"."source_token" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') and "payroll_monthly_entry"."command_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

payroll_attendance_decision_scope.name: payroll_attendance_decision_scope
payroll_attendance_decision_scope.value: "payroll_attendance_decision"."version" > 0 and "payroll_attendance_decision"."month" between date '2000-01-01' and date '2100-12-01' and extract(day from "payroll_attendance_decision"."month") = 1 and length(trim("payroll_attendance_decision"."item_key")) between 3 and 160

payroll_attendance_decision_amounts.name: payroll_attendance_decision_amounts
payroll_attendance_decision_amounts.value: ("payroll_attendance_decision"."calculated_amount_minor" is null or "payroll_attendance_decision"."calculated_amount_minor" between 0 and 100000000) and ("payroll_attendance_decision"."override_amount_minor" is null or "payroll_attendance_decision"."override_amount_minor" between 0 and 100000000) and ("payroll_attendance_decision"."action" <> 'overridden' or "payroll_attendance_decision"."override_amount_minor" is not null) and ("payroll_attendance_decision"."calculated_seconds" is null or "payroll_attendance_decision"."calculated_seconds" between 0 and 2678400) and ("payroll_attendance_decision"."override_seconds" is null or "payroll_attendance_decision"."override_seconds" between 0 and 2678400)
